assets.name: warm-contemporary
assets.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: original portrait wall-art bitmap, used as a framed canvas texture in a real-time 3D apartment.
Primary request: An original Warm Contemporary abstract painting. Textured warm off-white and taupe ground, broad organically balanced muted olive forms, small restrained charcoal accents, subtly layered hand-painted surfaces.
Style/medium: tactile contemporary acrylic and plaster-like paint on canvas, understated gallery quality.
Composition/framing: portrait aspect ratio 2:3, flat front-facing artwork fills the complete image edge to edge; calm asymmetrical abstract composition with breathing room.
Color palette: warm off-white, taupe, muted olive, restrained charcoal.
Constraints: Show only the original painting. No frame, mat, border, room, wall, furniture, interior, perspective, shadow from an external frame, typography, signature, logo, or watermark. Opaque image. The painted surface must fill every edge.
